note: Judged from the actual-runtime captures in this folder at 1280x720 and at phone size. BASELINE frames are the v5 chromium-city pass in ../mahplaza-v5/. Where a gate is PARTIAL the shortfall is named rather than softened.
method: PHASE A was five parallel read-only audits over the MAHFITT app source and the scene modules, every claim cited to file:line. Three of this pass's largest changes exist because those audits MEASURED something that could not be seen by eye: the environment ring that lights every metal, the zero-degree open sky in the portrait hero frame, and the overlapping facility footprints.

gates.name: Major buildings read predominantly platinum / diamond / glass
gates.note: The root cause is fixed and the gain is large: a metal takes no diffuse light, so every metalness>=0.9 surface was lit solely by an environment ring whose own distribution was 'mostly dark, a few bright'. That ring is genuinely lit now, and a new low-metalness platinumLit grade carries every HORIZONTAL cap, which measured ~3,100 m2 of surface (canopy, terraces, aprons, path bands, 82 dressing trim parts) whose hex read 60-63% luminance and whose render read black. The floor, frontages, canopies, aprons and furniture now read platinum. PARTIAL because the three destination BODIES and the midground block masses are deliberately still dark: they are the value floor the platinum is measured against, and lightening them uniformly would flatten the world rather than brighten it. A further pass should widen the platinum FRAMING on those masses instead.

gates.name: Important corners rounded or bevelled
gates.note: Every box in buildings.js is chamfered with a chamfer scaled to the part. Furniture that the camera gets close to uses softMass (bevelSegments 3, curveSegments 6) rather than a single 45-degree facet. The eight distant horizon slabs are chamfered too — eight un-bevelled black rectangles was the repeated-box read this brief objects to.

gates.name: MAH GYM / MATCH / MARKET visually distinct
gates.note: Three silhouette treatments: a swept curved glazed canopy, three receding roof terraces, a 22 m tower on a banded shoulder. Distinguishable in the overlook and arrival frames without reading a sign.

gates.name: The facilities have real spacing
gates.note: v5's separation was DEPTH ONLY. Measured from the arrival camera the three overlapped in bearing, and their side wings physically collided: MAH MATCH's apron OVERLAPPED MAH MARKET's left wing, and MAH GYM's right wing stood 0.40 m from MAH MATCH's apron. The side wings grew each facility by 68% of its own width, so the secondary mass grows BACKWARD now — a set-back rear volume — and the sites moved apart laterally. The overlook frame shows open ground between all three.

gates.name: Facades have depth
gates.note: Recessed reveals, angled inset crystal panels, corner turns with platinum edges, window courses, rear volumes, and signage built into the wall rather than printed on it.

gates.name: Building materials vary
gates.note: Four background families — bright platinum, dark crystalline glass, soft graphite, restrained violet-grey — assigned INDEPENDENTLY of archetype, so shape and surface are two separate variables. In v5, 26 of 39 towers wore one of two materials.

gates.name: Background structures are not all identical
gates.note: Material variety and the three distant depth bands are in. PARTIAL because the fifteen midground blocks are still one geometry recipe at fifteen scales — the same core mass, four corner pilasters, spandrel bands at one pitch, one crown and one window module. Two or three distinct block families are the outstanding work.

gates.name: The skyline does not form one continuous wall
gates.note: Measured before: the widest hole anywhere in the landscape arrival frame was 3.4 degrees, refilled to 0.4 by midground blocks, and the PORTRAIT arrival frame had ZERO open sky to the horizon at any bearing. Three valleys are now cut — right 52-72, centre 108-124, left 128-142 — with the towers, slabs and blocks that closed them removed and nothing moved in to compensate. Megatalls went from twelve to eight.

gates.name: Mountain ranges remain visible
gates.note: They were never visible: sky.js:122 gates them behind an empty `if (ctx.cityPresent) { }` whose comment promises a horizon backstop it does not build, and its generator places every peak at negative x because the bearing sweep never lets cos(a) change sign. terrain.js builds three ranges at 700 / 1050 / 1500 m rising to 820 m, concentrated in the three valleys, with aerial perspective baked into vertex colours because the night fog far plane of 880 m erases anything past 860.

gates.name: Open natural corridors exist
gates.note: The three valleys are open from the plaza to the horizon, and the land ring carries the world from 600 m to 1750 m beyond the city's own ground, which now stops at 620 m instead of 900 so it cannot paint over the land.

gates.name: Landscaping is present
gates.note: Fifteen groves of 148 trees plant the valleys between city and land. PARTIAL: this is MID-DISTANCE planting. The plaza itself still has only six planters over ~5,800 m2 of deck, and near-camera vegetation is the outstanding work.

gates.name: Future water areas remain spatially possible
gates.note: One still basin is built in the right valley at bearing 62, 330 m out, sized 210 x 130 m — deep dark blue at roughness 0.04 and metalness 0.92 so the sky, moon and FOBEAM field reflect in it rather than it glowing. Nothing in city.js, ground.js or buildings.js occupies that region, and the ground around it is left clear for a larger system.

gates.name: The city no longer consumes the entire world
gates.note: The overlook and valley views show city, open ground, planting, water and mountains in one frame.

gates.name: Residents move through the world; training is visible
gates.note: Carried from v4/v5 and still running: walkers on a path network, conversation groups, building entries, and the eight ambient events.

gates.name: MAHBEINGS attempt flight; beginner attempts read as beginner; advanced flight is rare; no chaos
gates.note: Seven states built as ONE arc parameterised by skill, so a beginner and an advanced resident run the same code and differ only in how far they get and how cleanly. Verified by advancing the world 420 seconds deterministically: hover attempt x5, steady hover x3, failed attempt x3, short flight x2, flight lesson x1 — beginners common, the three-resident lesson rarest — alongside all eight original events, never more than three active. A failed attempt is a small lift, a tilt the resident corrects, and a controlled settle; nobody falls.

gates.name: Canonical MAH branding, not generic substitute typography
gates.note: Read out of the app source rather than approximated: Space Grotesk, uppercase, tight title tracking (.055-.10em) against wide sub-line tracking (.16-.42em), the tracked-line centring rule, and weight 700 — the world had been asking for 800, which NO page in the repository loads, making it a faux-bold. THE DEPARTURE: the canonical identity colour is champagne gold #E9C98F (every opaque pixel of images/mahfitt-mark-gold.png is exactly that value), and MAHWORLD's own light law LAW-001 forbids it — hue 38.7 at 0.67 saturation. Both concept images render the facility names in cool white and the reference manifest recorded this in v3, so the world takes every canonical property EXCEPT the hue, in the one cream that passes (#EFEAE0). BRAND.gold is kept in materials.js as the record; relaxing the light law for signage is a one-line change.

gates.name: Signage physically integrated, not flat text on a wall
gates.note: A faceted backing panel recessed into the facade, a mirror-grade chromium frame with real mounting depth behind the wordmark plane, and a lit reveal along the lower edge washing the letters from below.

gates.name: Furniture reads as designed objects, not dark cutouts
gates.note: Benches gained a dark plinth set back so the seat overhangs, curved corners, a platinum nosing and an unlit strip in the overhang's shadow. Plinths are hollow with a rim, recess and interior wash. Rail posts and bollards gained base plates and caps on the low-metalness grade while their shafts keep metalness 1.0. Shelters gained lit soffits. A real bug was fixed: the info pylon's lit face was offset along the wrong axis and sat 0.2 m BEHIND its own body, single-sided, facing into its back.

gates.name: Ecosystem cameras and the phone-vertical hero banding
gates.note: Four ecosystem views are in — right valley, centre valley, overlook, natural edge — and join the core review set. The phone-vertical banding is to be judged from the portrait frames in this folder.

gates.name: Performance discipline
gates.note: Terrain costs 8 draw calls and 6,706 triangles for 66 peaks and 148 trees. The whole scene sits at 578-816 draw calls and 120k-141k triangles across the review set, with 12 lights and 62 shadow casters — the same order as v5 despite the added world. Frame times here come from headless software GL and are NOT phone numbers.

discrepancies: The fifteen midground city blocks are still one geometry recipe at fifteen scales. Material and depth variety were added around them; their massing was not.

The three destination bodies and the block masses remain dark on purpose, as the value floor the platinum reads against. The brief's platinum-first target is met on the floor, frontages, canopies, aprons and furniture but not yet on the primary elevations.
Near-camera vegetation is still six planters over the whole deck; the new planting is mid-distance.
The reserved square-diamond mark slot on the three signs is still empty: no verified FOB or MAHFITT mark file has been supplied.

Banner copy shown in the concept image (FIGHT HIGHER, LIVE HIGHER, SKILL BUILDS PEOPLE, HUMAN POTENTIAL LIVES HERE, CONNECT TRAIN COMPETE SHOP BELONG) is NOT in the world: none of it was verifiable in the app source, and inventing slogans is outside what this work may do. TRAIN HIGHER is present because it already existed in the scene.
Frame times come from headless software GL on a shared 4-core machine and are inflated; only draw calls, triangles, lights and shadow-caster counts are device-independent.
